build_vit_backbone: build a pretrained ViT-B/16 backbone with hooks and readout operations for monocular depth estimation
build_vitl_backbone: build a pretrained ViT-L/16 backbone with 1024 features for monocular depth estimation
build_deit_backbone: build a pretrained DeiT-B/16 backbone with hooks for monocular depth estimation
build_vit_rn50_backbone: build a pretrained ViT-B with ResNet-50 hybrid backbone for monocular depth estimation
